question: **‘All of a sudden, everything went quiet and that silence was the worst.’ The narrator felt so because:**

options.text: it indicated everyone had run away
the narrator was afraid of dying
the narrator was alone to manage the kitchen
it appeared as if everyone around had been shot

solution:
The correct answer is: **it appeared as if everyone around had been shot**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first and second sentence of the last paragraph in the given passage states that- *"All of a sudden, everything went quiet and that silence was the worst__. I tried looking around for survivors, __but it was just me__. I stayed there for a few hours, until I realised that __no help would be coming anytime soon__."*
 
• That means "**The narrator thought so because it looked like everyone in the area had been shot and no one is left****.**"

From here we can conclude that option 4 is the right answer.
